description: renders L-system fractals and explores their successive rewriting iterations.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-lsystem label="Koch curve">
  <script type="tp/lsystem">
    axiom: F
    iterations: 3
    angle: 60
    rule: F => F+F--F+F
  </script>
</tp-lsystem>

attributes.name: angle
attributes.description: Optional turning-angle override in degrees; empty uses the definition.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Milliseconds between playback iterations, at least 100.

attributes.name: iterations
attributes.description: Optional iteration override from 0 to 12; empty uses the source or preset value.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible caption and accessible SVG name.

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description: Built-in definition used when no source is supplied.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Source file; takes precedence over the internal script and preset.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Optional positive drawing-step override; empty uses the definition.

methods.name: exportSvg(): string
methods.description: Returns the current standalone SVG for export integrations.

methods.name: pause(): void
methods.description: Pauses playback without changing the displayed iteration.

methods.name: play(): void
methods.description: Starts user-requested playback, stopping at the final iteration without looping.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Pauses and restores iteration zero, the unexpanded axiom.

methods.name: step(): void
methods.description: Advances one iteration; reaching the limit restarts at the axiom on the next step.

events.name: tp-lsystem-rendered
events.description: Emitted after an iteration has been drawn.

userHelp.introduction:
The custom `<tp-lsystem>` element renders L-system fractals and explores their successive rewriting iterations.
It reuses the grammar, presets, turtle interpreter and SVG renderer of `@tp/tp-utilities`, also used by the L-system extension of `@tp/tp-markdown`.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Step | Pause and advance one rewriting iteration. After the final iteration, return to iteration zero. |
| Play / Pause | Play successive iterations or pause on the current one. Starting from the final iteration restarts at zero; playback stops at the final iteration. |
| Reset | Pause and display the axiom at iteration zero. |
| Save image | Choose SVG, PNG or WebP to download the current drawing. |
| Iteration counter | Read the current iteration and the definition's maximum. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between playback and export controls. |
| Enter / Space | Activate the focused button. |
| Escape | Close the image export menu. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
